about: The two mainnet contracts the sandbox harness runs as they are (vault.md 5 and V3.1): each pinned by sha256, size and NEAR code hash (base58 of the sha256). tests/harness/fetch-wasm.mjs reads each one's code by view_code on both RPCs below and refuses any bytes that are not the pin; the harness refuses them again when it loads them. The bytes are never committed: they go to a cache outside the checkout.

usdc.what: Circle's native USDC on NEAR (FiatToken), the token the mainnet vault build names (src/constants.rs TOKEN)
usdc.source: the code deployed at the account, read by view_code; Circle publishes no NEAR source or release, so the deployed bytes are the only source (vault.md Pinned sources, USDC row, read 2026-10-25 at block 221,596,474)

intents.what: NEAR Intents' verifier (defuse), the account the vault build names (src/constants.rs INTENTS)
intents.source: DF: github.com/near/intents tag defuse/v0.4.5 = commit 16d04f6ec4401263f8914638710260da50bb46b0 (git ref read 2026-11-01); the tag has no GitHub release, so the bytes are the code deployed at intents.near, read by view_code. Its own NEP-330 contract_source_metadata names version 0.4.5, link https://github.com/near/intents/tree/16d04f6ec4401263f8914638710260da50bb46b0 and build image sourcescan/cargo-near:0.22.0-rust-1.97.1@sha256:7467038bdddc86484b73b416eeadce926ff59013e128e53dec5a19e1cb4b2234; the harness checks that view in the sandbox
